member.name: E:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbClient.OnConnected
member.summary: Fired after IdentityToken received AND initial subscription applied.

member.name: E:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbClient.OnTableInsert
member.summary: Fired for every inserted row in any subscribed table.

member.name: E:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbClient.OnTableDelete
member.summary: Fired for every deleted row in any subscribed table.

member.name: E:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbClient.OnReducerEvent
member.summary: Fired when a reducer transaction update arrives (status = "Committed" | "Failed" | ...).

member.name: E:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbClient.OnError
member.summary: Fired on any WebSocket or parse error.

member.name: M:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbClient.ConnectAsync
member.summary: Full connection flow: 1. POST /v1/identity → get identity + auth token 2. POST /v1/identity/websocket-token → get a short-lived WS token 3. Open WebSocket with ?token=... OnConnected fires after IdentityToken + first InitialSubscription.

member.name: M:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbClient.Subscribe(System.String[])
member.summary: Subscribe to one or more table names. Generates "SELECT * FROM {table}" for each. Safe to call before ConnectAsync() — queries are queued.

member.name: M:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbClient.SubscribeWithQuery(System.String[])
member.summary: Subscribe with raw SQL query strings.

member.name: M:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbClient.CallReducerAsync(System.String,System.Object[])
member.summary: Invoke a reducer via HTTP POST. Args are serialised as a JSON array: ["arg1", 42, true, ...]. Pass no args or null for zero-argument reducers.

member.name: M:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbClient.Tick
member.summary: Call this every frame (e.g. from a Component's OnUpdate). Sends a WebSocket ping frame if the keepalive interval has elapsed. Required because SpacetimeDB MainCloud closes idle connections after ~30s.

member.name: M:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbClient.ArrayRowToObject(System.String,System.Text.Json.JsonElement)
member.summary: Converts a positional array row from TransactionUpdate into a named-property JsonElement so downstream code can use TryGetProperty() uniformly. Column order must match the struct field order in your SpacetimeDB module.

member.name: T:SpacetimeDB.SpacetimeDbComponent
member.summary: Drop on a GameObject and configure in the Inspector. Calls ConnectAsync() on Start if AutoConnect is true.
